Sandbox_TrippingZombiesMPFix_Enabled_too: On: Tripping Zombies' trips and falls are rolled only by the game that runs the zombie, and every other player's copy of that zombie trips the same way a moment later. Hit knockdowns are rolled by that game too, so everyone sees them. Off: Tripping Zombies works as without this add-on (each game trips its own copies; other players see them teleport). Every player needs the add-on. Applies at once, also when an admin changes it in a running game.
Sandbox_TrippingZombiesMPFix_SyncGetUp: Copies get up with the real zombie
Sandbox_TrippingZombiesMPFix_SyncGetUp_t: A copy that tripped gets up as soon as the zombie on the other player's screen gets up, instead of lying on for its own 1-3 s while the zombie runs away (that is what got it teleported).
Sandbox_TrippingZombiesMPFix_Log_tooltip: Writes every forwarded trip and a stats line every minute to console.txt ([TZMPFix] lines). For bug reports; leave it off otherwise.
